requests.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one 28x28 pixel Korean early-2000s MMORPG inventory weapon icon, delivered as a larger square master image for final downsampling. Image 1 is the exact currently approved weapon design, preserve its silhouette and identifying parts. Image 2 is a contact sheet of existing game icons, STYLE AND COMPOSITION REFERENCE ONLY; do not copy those obsolete weapon designs. Create ONE single weapon on completely solid black #000000 background, no gradient, no ground, no drop shadow, no text, no gold frame or other border (the original UI frame will be reapplied unchanged). Center it on square canvas, diagonal from bottom-left handle/end to top-right tip, fills about 88% of the square diagonal while all details stay fully within the canvas with black padding. Preserve exact blue, silver and subtle warm gold material palette. Crisp simple clusters, broad readable highlighted edges, restrained painted shading matching the low resolution inventory icons, no aura or particles. Simplify tiny engraving only as needed for 28x28 legibility. The silhouette is the priority. No inventing extra spikes or changing the weapon type. This is the long S-curved BLUE MOON S4 SWORD from image 1: preserve the long flowing blue/silver single blade, the big open crescent curl on one side of its guard, the flowing opposite guard and small straight dark-blue grip. In the actual current model only the BLADE has been elongated by 12% and thickened about 10%; the original hilt remains unchanged. Draw that slightly longer blade proportion. Sword point top-right, pommel bottom-left, blade and crescent opening clearly readable. Entire weapon fits, no cropping.
